Name: Starr's Springer Spaniel
Author: Starrleigh
Description:
I created this simple retexture mod for myself to add my dog into my game. Decided I'd share it in case others want a cute, unique Springer Spaniel running around their farms.
(Doesn't replace any in-game pets.)

If there's an error with this mod, please let me know, since this is my first time making a mod!

Manifest.Name: Starr's Springer Spaniel
Manifest.Description: Adds a new dog breed, the Springer Spaniel!
Manifest.Author: Starrleigh
